original_query: What does DEVOPS connect to in the diagram?

summaries.summary: The image displays the 'Enterprise DevOps Adoption Model' as a house-shaped diagram with three main sections: Principle, Management Framework, and Practices, under a 'Value/Purpose' roof, and an 'Environment' base. Arrows indicate questions guiding the model: 'How can we develop people?' and 'How can we improve the work?' The model aims to continuously deliver customer value with improved lead time, resilience, and quality.
key_facts: The model is titled 'Enterprise DevOps Adoption Model'.
Value/Purpose: Continuously deliver customer value in a sustainable way with improved lead time, resilience, and quality.
Principle: Self-directed team, Course correction over perfection, Automated over Manual.
Management Framework: People first, Organizational structure, Capability development, Budget, Risk management, Asset management, Change management, Security management.
Practices: Infrastructure as code, Dashboard, Working backwards, Open source, DevOps skill matrix, Audit automation, Self service, And etc.
Environment: People, Organization, Laws, Regulations, Culture, Competitors.
Arrows point to questions: 'How can we develop people?' and 'How can we improve the work?'
